newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt arrests 45 for forming illegal group.
newsitem.headline: Egypt arrests 45 for forming illegal group.

text.p: Egyptian authorities have arrested 45 people suspected of being Moslem militants for forming an illegal group, security sources said on Tuesday.
They said most were arrested in poor neighbourhoods of Imbaba, Warraq and Bulaq el-Dakror in Giza but did not say when.
The public prosecutor ordered them held in custody for 15 days pending investigations, the sources added.
Authorities seized publications stating the group's goals.
They were accused of planning to carry out "crimes against the constitution...that could destabilise security and public order," the sources added.

The prosecution said the group was not linked to the two main militant groups -- Gama'a al-Islamiya (Islamic Group) and al-Jihad (Holy war) -- fighting a low-scale guerrilla war since 1992 to overthrow the government and set up a strict Islamic state.
More than 1,000 people, mainly militants and policemen, have been killed in Egypt since Islamist groups took up arms.
